**How this suggestion is accepted:** it is a draft pull request into `sarif-issue29-20260929-b`, the branch of #63. A draft cannot be merged: someone with write access first marks it ready for review. The author of #63 then decides whether to merge it, and #63 carries the change to its base. Once #63 is merged or closed, this pull request can be closed.

```
Requests time out after 30 seconds.
```

**Level:** warning

The documented timeout disagrees with the client default of 10 seconds; update the guide and the reference together.

**Fix:** Document the 10-second timeout everywhere.
